biggest_catch: Payment can take up to 10 business days after your session — and the researcher can withhold or reduce payment if you don't complete everything.
catches: Official policy: 'This process can take up to 10 business days from when you completed your session.' Not same-day.
The researcher reserves the right to withhold or offer partial payment if you don't complete participation in its entirety.
Late arrival: the researcher can withhold payment or cancel your session; multiple no-shows can disqualify you from future studies.
Incentives are mostly digital gift cards via Tremendous (1000+ options incl. cash rewards and prepaid cards); direct cash depends on the study.
You must give 24-hours notice for cancellations/reschedules.

eligibility: Varies by study (screeners average ~2 minutes); must complete the full session and meet the study's participant criteria.
maximize: Only apply to studies where you genuinely match the screener — the qualifying details are shown upfront, so skip the ones you'd fail and save your effort for real matches. Show up on time and finish every part of the session, because the official policy lets researchers withhold or cut payment for incomplete participation or lateness. When your Tremendous reward link arrives, pick a cash-like option (virtual Visa or prepaid card) instead of a store gift card you'll never use. And keep applying: screeners take about 2 minutes, so volume is the strategy — one good study a week at $50+ beats dozens of survey pennies.

steps: Create a User Interviews participant profile.
Browse studies; each lists its incentive amount upfront — apply only to ones you qualify for.
Complete the short screener and get selected.
Attend the session on time (24h notice needed for changes) and complete it in full.
Receive the full listed incentive via Tremendous (gift cards, prepaid/virtual cards, or cash rewards) within up to 10 business days of researcher confirmation.
timing: Paid after researcher confirms successful completion; up to 10 business days from session completion. Incentives via Tremendous (1000+ options including cash rewards, prepaid/virtual cards, gift cards).
payout_value_note: variable per-task pay shown in-app before accepting; no fixed amount in official terms

who_pays: The researcher running the study pays your incentive through User Interviews — sent via Tremendous (cash rewards, prepaid or virtual cards, gift cards).
who_qualifies: Varies by study — you must meet the study's participant criteria. Screeners average about 2 minutes; you must complete the full session.
work_available: Study-by-study — you apply to studies and must pass each study's screener to be invited; getting picked depends on the researcher needing your profile.
what_gets_accepted: You must complete the full session and meet the study's criteria. The researcher can withhold or reduce payment for incomplete participation; late arrivals can lose payment, and you must give 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: screeners (about 2 minutes each, and most won't lead to a study). Multiple no-shows can disqualify you from future studies.
when_cash_arrives: Paid after the researcher confirms your successful completion — this can take up to 10 business days from your session. Incentives come via Tremendous (1000+ options including cash, prepaid/virtual cards, and gift cards).
